summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for $3,255,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due June 30, 2032. The notes are linked to the worst-performing of three indices (DJIA, Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000) and are issued under a shelf registration. They pay contingent coupons and are callable monthly after nine months. This is a routine structured note offering, not a special situation; the filing describes standard terms of a medium-term note program with no change-of-control, merger, or extraordinary corporate action.
